rules.requirement: Legal name, date of birth and identity document with number and expiry date.
Proof of residential address dated within three calendar months of assessment date.
Legal name, registration number, jurisdiction and formation evidence.
Ownership evidence identifying beneficial owners and their ownership percentages; identify controllers.
Flag identity documents expired before the assessment date; unknown expiry is not a pass.
Flag conflicting evidence and unreadable or unsupported documents for human review.
